title: Kusanagi Nene — Wonder Wand〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - Class 1-B

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Sigh, lunch break at long last.
Hey, where should we go for lunch today?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: How about the courtyard, since the weather's pretty good?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Yes, the weather's great, but any time spent moving around is time I can't use to enjoy my lunch break.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Instead, I should use that time to complete some daily missions or spend some stamina in the games that I'm playing...)
Neeeneee♪ Where aaare youuu? Ahh!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Hm? I've heard that voice somewhere before...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: There you are, Nene! Found you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, what?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehehe, here I am♪
Let's have lunch together, Nene♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh... No... Whaaaaaat?!
Kamiyama High School - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I was so surprised, Nene!
I've never heard you shriek so loudly before!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I didn't know I had it in me either...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Sigh... I'm so surprised that my heart is still beating
so quickly.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I have so many questions, like what're you doing here? Outsiders aren't allowed on school grounds, you know? But...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Anyway, let's have lunch together♪
I'm sooo hungry!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Yup, it's not like she's going to get the hint, and it'll just make me more tired, so I guess that's that.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay... I don't think anyone will be coming to the rooftop, so we should be safe here.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(There's nothing I can do today, I guess...
But she's really going to get caught and scolded by the teachers one day.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Well, since we've already found our lunch spot, I'll call Miku out now♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yaaay♪ Hi ho, Emu!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Oh, we're having lunch with Nene today, right?
Hi Nene!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wh-What's going on?
Why is she appearing like it's completely normal?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? You didn't know, Nene? If you have a smartphone capable of playing holograms, you can have a normal conversation with Miku like this!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yup yup! I can totally appear on your smartphone too, Nene!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Just wait for it...
And now I'm saying hello from Nene's smartphone!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wow, you're right...
No wait, that's not what I meant!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um, when did you start talking with Miku like this, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let me see... When she came to cheer me on during my school's sports day, I think♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <After that, Emu told me I was welcome to visit her at school anytime, and so I did♪>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, okay... Does that mean you can appear like this on anybody's smartphone?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Nah, only from smartphones loaded with songs that were born from true feelings.>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ah, someone else is here? Let's get them to have lunch with us too! Food always tastes better when we eat them together with someone else♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, we can't let people find out that there's an outsider in the school! You need to hide, quickly—

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Whoa! I knew I heard her voice!
Emu, what're you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Eh, Tsukasa?
And Rui too? But how come?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Tsukasa and Rui!
Yahohoy!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yahohoy yourself! Do you know what you've done?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Uhh, am I not welcome here? It's so sad that I'm the only one in a different school, and I only wanted to have lunch together with Nene...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ugh... I mean I understand how you feel, but it's still not good to break into another school like this.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In that case, why don't we all gather at SEKAI for lunch?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hmm?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Considering the short travel time and lower risk of being discovered by the teachers, it's a lot better to eat there, don't you think?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <That's a great idea, Rui!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Alright♪ Now I can always have lunch together with Nene and Tsukasa and Rui♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What? Us too?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Of course! And if we're all together, we can talk about our shows too!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Lunch is starting to sound very entertaining now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Emu looks happy about this. I'm always eating lunch alone anyway, so it doesn't matter if I have it at school or in SEKAI, I guess...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But why does she want to eat lunch with me so much?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'm not going to ask her, though, it's too embarrassing... I could just be overthinking this, anyway.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Oh... I know. I could send a message.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And then I was like—ah, hang on. I just got a message.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh?! Hehehe♪
You get an immediate reply♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Hm? She replied already.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: <Because Nene is a dear friend of mine!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (A dear...friend...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (You already have so many other friends, though...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But this feels kind of nice, I guess.)
